HELD LOCALLY since 2026-11-11 (gem-data.zip). Plants making ammonia, methanol, olefins and aromatics, with equipment, feedstock and capacity per product. Loaded by gem_extract.py: capacity per plant for the ammonia, methanol, propane-dehydrogenation and steam-cracker archetypes, classified by GEM's equipment and feedstock fields. Scope rule: Canada where three or more plants report the value, else North America, else global (Brad 2026-11-11). Traps: capacity is per plant, not per train (CF Medicine Hat's two trains are one row); steam crackers print ethylene only, so the HVC capacity is derived with the ethane ratio 1.14; Nutrien Joffre makes ammonia from by-product hydrogen and Sherritt's equipment is 'other', so neither counts as an SMR plant; aromatics capacities sit on refinery reformers (no archetype here). Not loaded: aromatics, butadiene, and refinery propylene. Canadian roster in _canada-stock.csv (for calibrating CIMS shares later).
